about: Tool presetter: an optical CAT40 presetter of the Zoller smile / Parlec class on its two-door steel cabinet (drawer, bar handles, plinth): a white cast base with an anthracite top and three fascia keys, the precision spindle (black, a clamp lever) holding a CAT40 shrink-fit holder and a 20 mm four-flute end mill, the column at the right (Z guide, cover strip, cap), the Z-carriage with its fine-adjust knobs and release key, the X-arm ending in the optics fork round the tool's corner (camera lens in front, backlight behind), and the touch monitor on its post at the back left, lit, showing the backlit silhouette, a crosshair, X/Z/R readings and soft keys. No maker's name or logo: the record is generic. Self-made in Blender (sources/preset/build_preset.py) where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.tool_presetter) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled; look sheets and three.js before/after checked
